description:
Job Title: Software Engineer 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
 
Anticipated Posting End: 9/28/2027 
 
 The Opportunity: 
CACI is seeking a cleared Software Engineer to work in Colorado Springs, CO.


 Responsibilities: 

 Development, operation, and maintenance of unique software capabilities leveraging industry standard frameworks.
 Development of microservices, standalone code, design and interface development, software tests, automation scripts, etc. using a variety of object oriented and scripting languages.
 Develop within the GitLab application lifecycle management suite of tools leveraging industry and program/project standards and workflows such as pull requests within Git, task/issue management using GitLab issue boards, interaction with external applications and environments such as AI agents, AWS GovCloud hosted resources, etc.
 Interfaces with software engineering and cross-functional engineering teams at daily standups and during task execution across the development lifecycle. May also interface with customers, application users, and other technical and support personnel.

 
 Qualifications: 

 Required:  

 BA or BS in related engineering field or a minimum of five years of related work experience.
 Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
 Experience working independently while decomposing complex or difficult coding problem sets.
 Proven technical individual development contributor, with demonstrated ability to interact with software development and cross-functional engineering teams.
 Familiarity with Linux operating systems and appropriate third-party applications for used in tactical and embedded systems. Example third-party applications include, but are not limited to: SQL-based databases, AstroUX framework, Terraform/Ansible (or other similar infrastructure and automation tools), etc.

 Desired: 

 Proficiency in version control systems, particularly Git.
 Understanding of microservices architecture principles.
 Basic understanding of Docker and containerization concepts.

 
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$82,100-$172,400 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
